pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Buildbot's base web (React) UI. Install one or more of dev-util/buildbot-console-view, dev-util/buildbot-grid-view, dev-util/buildbot-waterfall-view or dev-util/buildbot-wsgi-dashboards alongside it for the actual view plugins.
Re-added to this overlay after ::gentoo removed it (bug #952430, 2026-08-21) for lack of a maintainer and Python 3.13 support.
